name: progress_inventory
command: import json,pathlib; root=pathlib.Path("results/reconstruction_compression_20260914"); runs=[json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in (root/"runs").glob("*.json")]; print("completed_seconds",sum(r.get("wall_seconds",0) for r in runs)); print("intervals",[(p.parent.name,json.loads(p.read_text()).get("width_mHa")) for p in (root/"candidates").glob("*/interval.json")]); print("pending",[r["name"] for r in runs if r["status"]=="starting"])
